[[File:Matt Potter 1998 Worlds.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Matt Potter, 1998 World Championship.]]
[[File:Matt Potter 1998 Worlds card.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Player card in ''Star Wars Insider'' #43.]]
'''Matt Potter''' of Duluth, Minnesota, is the 1998 SWCCG World Champion (United States), the first American winner.<ref name="insider43">Ryan Morris, "The Thrill of Victory", ''Star Wars Insider'' #43, pp. 64–65. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials Star Wars Insider Magazines (1 to 153 + Specials)], Internet Archive. Facebook photographs, Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016012404/https://swccg.com/snapshots/facebook/insider-1998-worlds-p64.html Internet Archive] (p. 64); [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016012452/https://swccg.com/snapshots/facebook/insider-1998-worlds-p65.html Internet Archive] (p. 65)</ref> He defeated [[Michael Riboulet]] 2 (+9) in the Operatives final at the Cavalier Hotel.

At the 1998 World Championships he played [[Michael Girard]].<ref name="decsq-girardmichael">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/girardmichael.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Gold 120 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000604073410/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/girardmichael.html Internet Archive]</ref>
